records.title: Evaluating the performance of LLM summarization prompts with G-Eval
records.description: Evaluating the performance of summarization prompts is a challenging concept. The normal comparison done by LLMs between the output and a ground truth is not feasible, as the answer is subjective and difficult to compare. One solution, known as G-Eval, uses GPT-4 to evaluate the quality of summaries without a ground truth. It performs evaluation across four dimensions: fluency, coherence, consistency, relevance; it then outputs numeric results, allowing for objective comparison between prompt iterations, and a cohesive and scientific experimentation process.

records.description: Evaluating the performance of machine learning models is crucial for determining their effectiveness and reliability.
